comment: Differential-verification corpus (ADR-019). Tiers: 'shareware' runs in CI from the freely redistributable quake106 data (scripts/harness/fetch_shareware.py); 'registered'/'rerelease' need locally provided game data ($QUAKE_GAME_DATA); 'mod' entries are skipped with a warning until their data is dropped into the game data directory. Goldens are keyed per {os}-{arch} under Misc/harness/goldens/.

requires.note: 1.06 pak0, identical in shareware and registered installs

entries.name: map-e1m2
entries.note: second shareware map so the per-frame server/edict hash covers more than one level

entries.name: e1m1-long
entries.note: Phase 7 T1.1: several-thousand-frame single-map run for deeper server/edict state-hash coverage than save-e1m1 (610 frames). Confirmed via -harnesscmds 'edicts' dumps that no player input is required for server activity: the two entry-room func_door edicts (classname 'door' post-spawn) open purely from the player touching them at spawn placement, and multiple monster_army edicts advance along path_corner patrol routes over the run

entries.name: e1m5-trains
entries.note: Phase 7 T1.1: pusher/elevator-heavy entry. e1m1/e1m2's func_train and func_plat entities all require a player-triggered button/trigger (confirmed absent activity over 3000-4000 frame no-input windows on e1m1 (plat only), e1m2, e1m3, e1m4, e1m7), but e1m5's 4 func_train entities have no targetname in the bsp entity lump, which the stock QC train_next spawn path treats as 'start moving immediately' rather than waiting for a trigger; confirmed dynamically via -harnesscmds 'edicts' dumps at frames 2/2000/4000/6000/8000 (edicts 21/23/26/29) that all four cycle continuously back and forth for the full 8000-frame run with zero player input, giving sustained SV_Physics_Train/pusher coverage

entries.name: e1m1-plat-crush
entries.note: Phase 7 T1.8 follow-up: fixes the physics_matrix.py 'KNOWN GAP' -- authors a corpus entry that genuinely exercises the sv_gameplayfix_elevators BLOCKED branch (Quake/sv_phys.c:704-705, gated further at sv_phys.c:1540-1546: only fires when an entity is riding a pusher (FL_ONGROUND with groundentity==pusher) and the pusher's move leaves it still embedded in the pusher -- i.e. an elevator crushing its rider, not a horizontal pusher merely shoving something out of its way sideways, which is unaffected by this cvar regardless of contact). e1m1's edict 22 func_plat (blocked=plat_crush()) has a static, always-active trigger_field (edict 23, touch=plat_center_touch(), no player-trigger/button needed) spanning its full travel column; 'setpos -544 2656 38' (frame 10) drops the player into that field just above the plat's resting top surface without embedding in solid BSP (confirmed by binary-search probing candidate coordinates via -harnesscmds 'edicts' dumps -- most of the plat's nominal x/y/z footprint is solid, this exact spot is the open landing), 'noclip' (frame 25) returns the player to MOVETYPE_WALK so it can be pushed/blocked rather than passing through. The plat immediately starts cycling and repeatedly crushes the rider (player health drops 100->79->65->50->23 over ~500 frames in manual verification), calling plat_crush() -> the SV_PushMove blocked path every cycle. Direct differential evidence (same exe, scripts/harness/run_corpus.run_entry with '0 sv_gameplayfix_elevators 0'/'3' prepended ahead of this entry's own cmds, per physics_matrix.py's cvar_cmds_for pattern): the two resulting hash chains first diverge at 'F 56' (frame 56, right as the player first lands on/is caught by the plat) and differ overall; a same-cvar rerun (elevators=0 twice) reproduces byte-identical output, so the divergence is the cvar, not nondeterminism. sv_smoothplatformlerps (the MOVETYPE_STEP walking-monster-on-a-lift axis) is NOT covered by this entry -- e1m1's nearby monster_dog (edict 118) wanders near the plat when the player is present but its patrol AI never actually steps into the trigger footprint within the frame budgets tried, and scripting monster movement precisely (no monster-equivalent of setpos) proved too fiddly to pin down in the time available; that axis remains open, still passing vacuously per physics_matrix.py's docstring

entries.name: e3m6-trains
entries.note: Phase 7 T1.1: registered-tier (PAK1) pusher/elevator-heavy entry, local-only like save-e2m1/gamedir-switch since it needs PAK1.PAK. e3m6's 2 func_train entities also have no targetname (same self-starting pattern as e1m5-trains); confirmed dynamically over a 6000-frame no-input run (edicts 10/15 mirror-cycle continuously)

entries.name: gamedir-switch
entries.note: mid-run 'game' command: exercises the COM_ResetGameDirectories teardown/reload path (Phase 2 fs gate). Registered tier because COM_Game_f refuses to run without the registered version, so CI (shareware tier) skips this entry - the headless guard it covers is regression-tested locally against the goldens, not in CI

requires.note: 2021 re-release id1 pak; QuakeEX.kpf localization is exercised by this entry

entries.name: music-wav
entries.note: Phase 4: committed synthetic WAV music through the codec framework/bgmusic; meaningful mainly under --sndhash (mixer PCM), harmless in the demo state hash. Registered tier for two independent reasons, so CI (shareware tier) skips it and the goldens are regression-tested locally like gamedir-switch: '-game' sets com_modified, which makes COM_CheckRegistered Sys_Error without the registered version, and COM_FindFile refuses any loose file whose name contains '/' when registered==0, which external music ('music/track90.wav') always does
